parole.significato: citron (the fruit of a citron tree)

parole.significato: daric, a gold coin from the Achaemenid Empire introduced by Darius the Great and discontinued by Alexander the Great.
parole.testo: From Old Persian *darikah (“daric”), itself from *dariš (“golden, yellow”) + -𐎣 (-kaʰ⁠, “hypocoristic suffix”), literally “little gold thing”.
